svg.title: Mallea: building, steering, and memorizing worlds with a coding agent
svg.desc: A coding agent uses shared object definitions to coordinate adaptive representations, programmable object behavior, and object texture memory. Runtime code advances an executable whitebox with optional user actions. A generative renderer uses current state and compatible object appearance. During a revisit, appearance is reused for an unchanged vase while a block whose material changed receives an updated texture. The agent revises memory decisions when object properties or rules change.
svg.text: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
Shared object definitions link representation, behavior, and memory
Refine only where interactions require it.
Leave other visual details to the renderer.
Properties and rules determine each response.
The agent decides what to retain or update
Memory persists outside the current view
The agent revises reuse decisions as object properties and rules change.
Build the objects. Steer their behavior. Remember their appearance.
